tagline: Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Sales is the primary indicator of the company's overall financial performance, reflecting its ability to generate revenue in a rapidly evolving automotive market characterized by the transition toward electric vehicles.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales generated by the company after deductions.
kpis.description: Net revenue decreased in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to lower production volumes on certain vehicle programs and the sale of a subsidiary.
kpis.signal: Decline in sales due to reduced production volumes on certain vehicle programs.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, before other expenses.
kpis.description: Gross margin remained stable at 12.1% in 2025 and 2024, impacted by the same factors affecting net sales.
kpis.signal: Stable gross margin despite revenue decline, indicating effective cost management in production.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by net revenue, indicating profitability of core operations.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined from 3.9% in 2024 to 1.9% in 2025, affected by costs related to the Dowlais acquisition and restructuring activities.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in operating margin, primarily due to restructuring and acquisition-related costs.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of net revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses decreased in 2025 compared to 2024, falling from $159.0 million to $147.0 million.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in R&D investments, potentially linked to focus on post-acquisition integration.

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total costs related to company operations, excluding cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Operating expenses increased in 2025, primarily due to acquisition and restructuring costs related to the Dowlais acquisition (SG&A $389M + Amort. $81.8M + Restruc. $113.4M = $584.2M core operations).
kpis.signal: Increase in operating expenses, mainly driven by acquisition and restructuring costs.

kpis.name: Cost of Goods Sold
kpis.explanation: Direct cost of goods or services sold by the company.
kpis.description: Cost of goods sold decreased in 2025, reflecting lower production volumes and the sale of a subsidiary.
kpis.signal: Decline in cost of goods sold, in line with lower production volumes.

kpis.name: SG&A Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to selling, marketing, administration, and general management.
kpis.description: SG&A expenses increased slightly in 2025, primarily due to higher incentive compensation expenses, partially offset by lower R&D spending.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in SG&A expenses, mainly due to higher incentive compensation costs.

kpis.name: Restructuring and Acquisition-Related Costs
kpis.explanation: Costs incurred for operational restructuring or related to acquisitions.
kpis.description: These costs increased significantly in 2025, primarily due to expenses related to the Dowlais acquisition and higher restructuring costs.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase in restructuring and acquisition-related costs, linked to the Dowlais acquisition.

kpis.name: Dowlais Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Strategic acquisition of Dowlais Group plc (GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy) completed on February 3, 2026.
kpis.description: On February 3, 2026, Dauch completed the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc for a total purchase price of approximately $1.7 billion, including the issuance of approximately 117 million shares and cash payments of $0.59 per former Dowlais share.
kpis.signal: The Dowlais acquisition transforms Dauch into a global driveline and metal forming supplier with operations in 24 countries.

kpis.name: AAM India Sale
kpis.explanation: Sale of subsidiary AAM India Manufacturing Corporation Pvt., Ltd. completed on July 1, 2025.
kpis.description: The sale of AAM India Manufacturing Corporation Pvt., Ltd. in July 2025 resulted in a $57 million reduction in consolidated net revenue and a $53 million decrease in cost of goods sold.
kpis.signal: The sale of AAM India reduced the company's net revenue in 2025.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruption
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on a few key suppliers for critical components and raw materials. A major supply chain disruption could lead to production delays, substantial cost increases, and significant sales losses.

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on three key customers: GM (44% of 2025 sales), Ford (15%), and Stellantis, collectively representing a significant portion of consolidated revenue. The loss of any of these customers or a reduction in their production volumes would have a material impact on operating results.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company faces cybersecurity risks including malware attacks, unauthorized access, and data theft, which could disrupt production operations, IT systems, and damage the company's reputation.

risks.title: New Product Launch Risks
risks.score_rationale: Dauch's commercial success depends on its ability to develop and launch innovative products aligned with the transition to electric vehicles and emerging mobility technologies. Failure in new product launches could reduce competitiveness and market share.

ai_positioning.summary: Dauch Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 fiscal year 10-K/20-F report.
